coverage.assessment: The cut of society's 'anarchistic ferments' and of the party's disdain for Baireuth leaves 'He too' and 'Yet Baireuth still amused' under-motivated (F1). After the upset to unity at Hammerfest, Adams no longer turns back to Russia to recover chaos (F3).
'Exactly the opposite condition' no longer has a stated American condition (F2). The Senator, the Lodges, Stockholm, Hammerfest on September 14 and the route south remain clear.
The only performed speech is the La Fontaine self-questioning ('Am I satisfied?' and the French lines), and it survives intact. The Senator exchange stays in summary, as in the source.

Lost: the admission that he could not affirm the synthesis would be chaos, and 'No one was to blame' (F4). Lost: the coal empire's 'jealousies might tear it apart' qualification (F7). The continuity facts (two members, Stickney and Bay Lodge, 1830, sixty-three, McKinley timeline) are correct.
The ironic third-person distance holds ('the tourist-student', 'the monkey', 'the newer Teufelsdrockh'). The ending reveals nothing about de Witte's fall.

The protected aphorisms all survive. Some self-deprecating closers are trimmed ('indigestible morsel'; the double-hyphen 'infinitely more--chaotic' glance). All of the Wagner flood imagery is cut (F5, F7).

The paradox that both America and Russia are conservative Christian anarchic, but in opposite modes, is blurred (F2). Adams's provisional estimate of the gap between east and west, an early attempt at mechanical measure, is dropped (F6).

Dependencies 0-3 are intact at both ends. For dependency 4, the local conditional ending survives, but the partner 034 revision cut de Witte's 'powerless dignity', so the watch has no payoff in the abridgment.

this prodigious ice-cap of vis inertiae

findings.claim: The revision cut two premises that the first draft kept: the sentence on New York/Paris society nursing anarchistic ferments credited to Wagner, and the party's finding 'no inspiration in Baireuth'. 'He too had played with anarchy' now has no antecedent anarchist. 'Yet Baireuth still amused' no longer contrasts with anything the party said.
findings.counterevidence: 'Too' can loosely be read forward, toward Bay Lodge and Stickney named in the next sentence. 'The rococo element jarred' gives 'Yet' some contrast.

evidence.quote: society nursed there, in the rottenness of its decay, certain anarchistic ferments, and thought them proof of art
Such a party saw no inspiration in Baireuth, where landscape, history, and audience were--relatively--stodgy
Wagner was chiefly responsible for them as artistic emotion
Adams had been carried with the tide till Brunhilde had become a habit and Ternina an ally. He too had played with anarchy.
Yet Baireuth still amused even a conservative Christian anarchist who came only to learn what Wagner had supposed himself to mean.

findings.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's 'society nursed there... anarchistic ferments... Wagner was chiefly responsible for them as artistic emotion'. Restore 'Such a party saw no inspiration in Baireuth'.
findings.plan_relation: Required: the essential calls for the Wagner/catastrophe section feeding the party, 'to restore true poetry under the inspiration of the Gotterdammerung'.
findings.reader_effect: The causal hinge is weakened: Wagner breeds anarchic emotion, which breeds the party. The party then reads as an abrupt aside rather than an outgrowth of the Baireuth section.
findings.title: Wagner-to-anarchy bridge severed; 'too' and 'Yet' lose their premises

findings.claim: The first draft already dropped 'The Czar's empire was a phase of conservative Christian anarchy' but kept the American condition: no complete union, and freedom to ignore contradiction. The revision cuts that too. 'Opposite condition' now points only at 'national, racial, geographic'. Russia is then called 'logical, conservative, Christian and anarchic' with no explanation of how that is the opposite of American conservative Christian anarchy.
findings.counterevidence: The radium and inertia images make Russia's difference vivid enough that readers infer a contrast of energy against inertia.

evidence.quote: The freedom gave him courage to meet any contradiction, and intelligence enough to ignore it. Exactly the opposite condition had marked Russian growth.
The true American had never known a complete union either in Church or State or thought, and had never seen any need for it.
In America all were conservative Christian anarchists; the faith was national, racial, geographic. Exactly the opposite condition had marked Russian growth.

findings.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's two sentences: 'The true American had never known a complete union... The freedom gave him courage to meet any contradiction, and intelligence enough to ignore it.'
findings.plan_relation: Required: the essential reads 'Americans are all CCAs by nature; Russia is the opposite.'
findings.reader_effect: The contrast between anarchy as American freedom and anarchy as Russian logical inertia reads as near-contradiction. That contrast is central to the chapter's Russia argument.
findings.title: 'Opposite condition' lacks its American referent; the America/Russia paradox blurs

findings.claim: The first draft kept two passages that the revision cut: the attempt to recover his grasp of chaos by looking back across the gulf to Russia, and the tourist's 'stupefying contrast with Russia'. In the revision, the upset to his philosophy of unity is followed directly by 'Yet the nightmare of the glacial ice-cap', so the dialectical counter-move disappears.
findings.counterevidence: 'The ice-cap of Russian inertia pressing from behind' later in the paragraph partly restores the Russian pole.

evidence.quote: To recover his grasp of chaos, he must look back across the gulf to Russia, and the gap seemed to have suddenly become an abyss.
To recover his grasp of chaos, he must look back across the gulf to Russia, and the gap seemed to have suddenly become an abyss.
The acceleration was marvellous, and wholly in the lines of unity. Yet the nightmare of the glacial ice-cap still pressed down on him from the hills

findings.minimal_repair: Reinsert the single 'To recover his grasp of chaos...' sentence before 'Yet the nightmare'.
findings.plan_relation: Supports essentials on acceleration upsetting his philosophy and on ancestors caught between ice and Russian inertia.
findings.reader_effect: The philosophy is upset but never re-balanced. The Russia gulf turning into an abyss, which sets up the ancestors pressed by Russian inertia, is lost.
findings.title: Hammerfest loses the turn back to Russia to recover chaos

findings.claim: The first draft kept two passages that the revision cut: the admission that he could not affirm that his synthesis would be chaos, since he would be obliged to deny the chaos, and 'No one was to blame, for all were equally servants of the power'. The paragraph now runs: darkness, steam throb, 'But... saw light.'
findings.counterevidence: 'Bay Lodge necessarily denied both the assumption and the principle' preserves some of the dialectical self-denial.

evidence.quote: He could not affirm with confidence, even to himself, that his "largest synthesis" would certainly turn out to be chaos, since he would be equally obliged to deny the chaos.
No one was to blame, for all were equally servants of the power, and worked merely to increase it
drowned rhyme and reason. But the conservative Christian anarchist saw light.

findings.minimal_repair: Restore 'No one was to blame, for all were equally servants of the power, and worked merely to increase it;' before 'but the conservative Christian anarchist saw light.'
findings.plan_relation: Required: the essential reads 'He admits the darkness: the throb... drowns rhyme and reason'. The voice profile emphasizes refusal of certainty.
findings.reader_effect: This loses the mock-pedantic self-contradiction that defines the party's voice. It also loses the human servitude to power that gives the steam image its point.
findings.title: Self-undercutting uncertainty and 'servants of the power' trimmed

findings.claim: The plan allowed cutting the rococo/Hudson/Susquehanna flood images but said to keep one. The first draft kept the Seine; the revision removes every flood image and the New York throngs. 'New York knew better than Baireuth' is now asserted without the experience that grounds it.
findings.counterevidence: The Paris/New York catastrophe contrast and the Fluch-motif closer survive.

evidence.quote: Even the Hudson and the Susquehanna--perhaps the Potomac itself--had often risen to drown out the gods of Walhalla
the frivolities of Paris had more than once included the rising of the Seine to drown out the Etoile or Montmartre
The rococo element jarred. New York knew better than Baireuth what Wagner meant. Paris still felt a subtile flattery

findings.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's Seine clause after 'what Wagner meant'.
findings.plan_relation: Optional cut, but the plan said 'keep one'; the revision misses that instruction.
findings.reader_effect: This flattens the comic mapping of Gotterdammerung onto modern cities. The New York side of the Paris/New York contrast is weakened.
findings.title: All Wagner flood images and the New York audience cut

findings.claim: The source and first draft follow the refusal to give an opinion with an ironic provisional calculation: a slow acceleration leaving the gap between east and west relatively the same. The revision goes straight to the Berlin decision, which also drops the link 'This result reached'.
findings.counterevidence: The essential protects only the silence and V5; the scene stays coherent without the estimate.

evidence.quote: one might give a value as movement of inertia to the mass, and assume a slow acceleration that would, at the end of a generation, leave the gap between east and west relatively the same
One might give a value as movement of inertia to the mass, and assume a slow acceleration
and their relations must be always infinite. The Lodges thought their moral improvement required a visit to Berlin

findings.minimal_repair: Optionally restore the first draft's single 'One might give a value...' sentence.
findings.plan_relation: Not listed as essential; defensible compression, though the book context stresses measuring history mechanically.
findings.reader_effect: This loses the irony of refusing opinion yet measuring anyway. It also loses an early instance of the mechanical measurement that anticipates the Law of Acceleration.
findings.title: Adams's provisional inertia estimate dropped after 'nothing to say'

findings.claim: The first draft kept 'Russia was the most indigestible morsel' and the 'jealousies might tear it apart' clause; the revision cuts both. The coal empire now stands unqualified, and the wry self-portrait is shortened.
findings.counterevidence: V8 and 'Beyond lay Russia... held its own' keep the Coal/inertia contrast intact.

evidence.quote: Political and human jealousies might tear it apart or divide it, but the power and the empire were one. Unity had gained that ground.
Russia was the most indigestible morsel he ever met
these three months of education were the most arduous he ever attempted; but the sum of it, viewed from Cologne, seemed reasonable.

findings.minimal_repair: Restore 'Political and human jealousies might tear it apart or divide it, but the power and the empire were one.'
findings.plan_relation: Optional; not named in the essentials.
findings.reader_effect: The empire of Coal reads as a flatter assertion. The tension between political division and the unity of power, which feeds the next chapters' Coal-power combination, is lost.
findings.title: Coal-empire qualification and the 'indigestible morsel' closer cut

strengths: All eight protected passages (V1-V8) appear verbatim and in sequence, including the Fluch-motif and 'worked better than the sun' closers.
The McKinley paragraph keeps its day-by-day accumulation from Stockholm to the dim haven, so the timing behind V7 is preserved.
The comic two-member dialectic survives with its punchline: Bay Lodge denies the principle 'in order to assure its truth'.
The full La Fontaine French verse and the 'monkey and motor were terribly afraid of the bear' line survive, with Stockholm as the monkey's vantage.
The ending keeps the de Witte/de Plehve watch strictly conditional, with no premature revelation.
summary: The revision keeps all eight protected passages, the McKinley news sequence, the two-member party dialectic, the La Fontaine verse, the ice-cap image and the conditional de Witte ending. Its extra cuts beyond the first draft leave a few logical joints dangling. The Wagner-to-anarchy bridge is cut, so 'He too' and 'Yet' lose their premises. The America/Russia contrast loses the American condition that 'opposite' refers to. The Hammerfest 'recover his grasp of chaos' move is gone. Several self-undercutting qualifications are trimmed. None is a blocker, but each warrants small source-grounded repair.
